items.claim: Cross-target redo left on other targets' scenes, so a pane's Redo brings back a discarded change
SVG export copies a `{ px }` stroke's dashes in user units, so they come out `scale`× too long
items.note: The same fix also stops the export from dropping a stroke's `dashOffset`.

items.claim: Mark-list title typing makes one undo step per keystroke
Legacy save restored before its target has a content box is never migrated
items.note: Reads, paint, exports and `update` now convert such marks whenever the content box is known, and an update writes the converted form back.

items.claim: Export panels share radio `name`s, so two open panels steal each other's choice
Restyle counter restarts at 1 when the palette remounts, so a new restyle folds into an old undo step
items.note: The count now lives in a shared module, `markGesture.ts`, which the mark list also uses.

items.claim: Calibration picture-ref map grows by one entry per trial and never shrinks
Restyle across targets lands one undo step per target
items.note: Updates sharing a `coalesceKey` now undo and redo together across a store's targets, and still do after a save and load. Across trials it stays one step per trial, because each trial owns its own undo.

items.claim: `AnnotationOverlayProps.scene` doc describes one scene shared by every target
items.note: It's a doc-only change, so it has no changeset.

items.claim: Target with no content box reads its marks at 0×0, and a geometry write collapses them to the origin
items.note: Reads now use the last content box with an area. This was a strict call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: `add`, and an `update` with `frac` or `points`, now throw on a target whose content box was never known; an update of meaning alone still lands.

items.claim: Status "—" stores `status: ''` instead of clearing it
API writes snap the world pose to 1/10,000 of the target
items.note: Rounding now applies only to what reads report.
